steps.content:
O dazzling morning star,
Shine beside the moon,
May you never lose your glory.

Stood above the stars,
Crossed the clouds in the far north, 
Sat on the peak of towering mountains.

On the verge of falling,
It was prophesied to fall from the heavens
Into a world of falsehood destined to vanish.
The communicator device is beeping, and three text messages in a row are sent to you.
You tap on the latest one. It asks you to the interrogation room ASAP. A Sinner has turned herself in and specifically requested to see you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Long time no see, my little monster.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Why the look? Do you not miss me at all?
Could you explain to me what happened to him, Miss Stargazer?
In the interrogation room, the exotic Sinner fiddles with the chains on her wrists. She seems to find being confined here a new and fresh experience.
At the door, several staff members are carrying a fainted person out of the room. He looks ghastly pale as if he had been shocked.
She glances in the direction you are pointing at, unconcerned.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I thought you're already used to it.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You know full well. This kind of thing always happens wherever I go.
Stargazer waves her hand nonchalantly. The trinkets and chains on her body make a jingling noise, which adds a touch of eeriness to the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They were interested in my prophecy skills.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Seeing as they were your colleagues, I prophesied for them.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Too bad they thought my prophecy was a joke, and tried to "teach me a lesson." But...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hey, am I really that frightening?
The staff members hiding outside the door behind you seem to be afraid of her and wishing for her to leave immediately. After a few grunts, they leave reluctantly.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Although my prophecies are not for free, seeing them making an exhibition of themselves could count as the fee, I guess.
Stargazer gives you a wink.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Of course, you're different, little monster.
You ignore her stare and sit in front of her.

options: Why did you insist on seeing me?

choices.text: Why did you insist on seeing me?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Of course it's because I've missed you.
...Thanks for your concern.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little monster, are you questioning my sincerity for you?
That’s not what I meant...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hehe... You used to be so bold. Now you can't even take a joke.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Never mind. The reason I came to see you... is to tell you a new prophecy.
Stargazer's lips curl up into a knowing smile, just like when you first met her in WhiteSands.
You can tell me, but as you know, I'm not... one to believe in prophecies.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Alright, alright.
Stargazer's smile grows deeper as she waves her right hand and brings a tarot card out of nowhere.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: My poor little monster...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: How should I tell you... this huge canvas known as fate...
Stargazer places the tarot card in front of her while gently shaking her head toward you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The tower rises over the zoo. Vultures, scorpions, jackals, hounds, vipers, monkeys...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They howl under the tall tower and dance in the mud to declare this sinful world...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: And you hang above this tower, tottering like the morning star...
What are you trying to say?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: A great catastrophe sweeping the world...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little monster, the world you love will inevitably come to an end because of the catastrophe.

options: The world will end one day.

choices.text: The world will end one day.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Then... why don't you go to the Realm of Truth with me? I have been looking for it for a long time. Until recently, I finally found its entrance seems to be stirring around you. You should be able to sense it too.

You frown. You have seen the Dreamflower with Stargazer, so you have a rough idea of where it came from. DisSea has been unstable lately, but you can't be sure that it's related to the so-called "truth" that Stargazer is mentioning.
As a human being born to this world, I have the right to choose to die with this world. I will not run away from death, Miss Stargazer.
As you should know, such words of bewitchment don't really work on me.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's not bewitchment. It is a prophecy. It's your... future path. You are destined to follow me.
As Stargazer says this, she picks up and shows you the second tarot card with her golden finger claws.
On the card, a thorny moon glows brightly in the sky. The animals that Stargazer just mentioned are gathering below, with their necks upturned, roaring vigorously.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Haha... it's the Moon upright.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You will embark on a journey filled with confusion and uncertainty... Everything will feel like being covered in the shadow...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The pale glow carries sharp thorns that will make your spine and heart ache.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Oh, my poor little monster. You need me, sweetie.

options: My journey has always been filled with those things.

choices.text: My journey has always been filled with those things.

steps.content: Stargazer quietly looks at you as if expecting you to say something.
But I won't back down. Sorry, Miss Stargazer. I know it's rude to interrupt your prophecy. Please continue.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: That's one of the things I like about you, my little monster.
Stargazer places the second card on the right side and draws a third one.
The moment she sees the card, Stargazer sighs and gazes at you in compassion.
If you got something to say, just say it.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Five of Cups. You will fall into the abyss of darkness. Alone and helpless, terror and sorrow will surround you and gnaw at your body and soul like ants eating flesh...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You are destined to walk through each and every painful hardship in your future journey.
Well, doesn't seem like any of these cards bring happiness.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Indeed, indeed... but you have me, my little monster.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I was able to make you suffer, then rise from the ashes in WhiteSands... Naturally, I can also save you from this false world and guide you to the path of truth.
Where is that path? How can you be sure that the truth lies at the end of it?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: All you have to do is follow me... My powers won't deceive me. You are very important to me.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: My companion, you are the key to the Realm of Truth.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Endless darkness lies beneath your blue pupils...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But, there is a hidden path to the truth in them...
You look to the side and the dark screen reflects your eyes, where a hint of its turquoise hue can be seen.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The Dreamflower shall return to the Void, and you shall give this false world the ending it deserves! You... shall unlock the truest Enlightenment!
Alright, Miss Stargazer. I don't have the time or energy to play along with your prophecies.
But if you tell me this so-called "path of truth" is near DisSea, I'd be happy to hear more about it.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hehe... Perhaps it is?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The path of truth lies in where your sight goes. That's why I've been so infatuated with you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Why... my little monster?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Behind those eyes as blue as the ocean and sky, is deep and empty darkness...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Yet I found a path towards the truth in that darkness... Though the Dreamflower returned to the Void, I am still searching in this false world... Could your body be the Realm of Truth? Could your soul be... the key?
Stargazer laughs as her voice starts to tremble.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hahaha... This world feeds everyone with foolishness and mistakes, which ultimately transform into sin inside one's belly.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: When evil rises and gnaws at their brain and spirit, people become blinded by falsehood.
I think I can see clearly right now.
Stargazer looks at you, her purple eyes as bright as the moon, twinkling with a hint of insanity.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Yes, I know you won't lose your way... After all, you are the darling of WhiteSands, welcomed even by the Void.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But here, even you will be overwhelmed by the hostile glares of all those scums.
I won't be.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Trust my prophecy... My little monster.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I'm here to save you.
I think I'm safer now than I was in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little monster, in this chaotic world, everyone has moments when they can't see their surroundings clearly.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: And here... There is neither sunshine nor starlight.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Not to mention clear moonbeam.
Stargazer holds out her hand as if invoking the descent of the gods.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Yes... I can feel it...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Your worries emit the same salty smell as the desert.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But you need not be afraid...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Only absurdity and falsehood will devour souls.
Stargazer's words make little sense, but they carry a power that cannot be ignored.
It chokes the spirit like an unforgiving tide that rises with the moonlight, forcing one down a path of no return.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: A journey filled with confusion and deception... A cast of vile and callous villains... Ultimately, you will be trapped in the lofty tower...
Is this the ending of your prophecy?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Yes... and they shall all come true.
I was able to survive WhiteSands last time. I can overcome this prophecy, too.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Then, time and fate will tell.
Sometimes, time and fate cannot escape the manipulation of humans.
You reach out and flip over the middle card, placing it before yourself.
A fourth tarot card appears on the table, which has been covered by the card you just flipped over.
Please explain this, Miss Stargazer.
Stargazer looks at the fourth card on the table and laughs soundlessly.
She picks up the card gently, squinting her eyes.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Just like you said... Time and fate cannot escape the manipulation of humans.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You have put this card in your future, with your own hands.
And what does this card represent?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: This flag and scythe couldn't be any more obvious.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Someone has drilled a hole, draining the contents inside and leaving but a dry shell.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Death... this hollow and fragile oak barrel represents a bleak death!
The path I take may not be your so-called "path of truth." I'm also well aware that this path is filled with dangers and thorns, and that at its end is the end of everything.
But these hardships will become my armor and sharpen my blade.
I will not let these so-called prophecies slow down my journey. Thank you for your advice, Miss Stargazer.
Stargazer cackles shrilly, sending a chill down the spine of everyone present.
The others still glare at her with a mixture of fear and malice.
What breaks this stalemate is an urgent order from the superior.

steps.speaker: FAC Liaison Officer
steps.content: Chief! There is an urgent request for help from the Broken Frontline in DisSea.

steps.speaker: FAC Liaison Officer
steps.content: A well-equipped team has attacked the base station near BR-000! That's the weakest point of the shield...

steps.speaker: FAC Liaison Officer
steps.content: We've also detected a sharp spike in M-value at the Frontline. Either there are Sinners assisting the attack, or... the attackers are already Corruptors.
So much for the interrogation. I'll be right over.
You glance at Stargazer. She still sits calmly before you with a smile on her face.
You pack up your things and turn to leave. An exotic scent seeps into your nose, putting you into a dizzy stupor, and you hear a voice from the distance.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: O Morning Star, O Morning Star...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Why do you fall from the sky, nine days and nights...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The journey of confusion and uncertainty is about to begin... my little monster...
